# Roleplay Rule 15 - Command and Marine Police must follow Corporate Law All non-antagonist command and Marine Police roles must obey [textlink="Corporate Law" link="CorporateLaw"]. This includes non-antagonists who are promoted to or gain a position during the round in any way. This also includes non-antagonists who are acting as a Marine Police role.
Corporate Law violations should be prioritized based on severity and the current situation.
This prohibits use of syndicate items outside extreme emergencies, including uplinks by command and the Marine Police. This also prohibits the preparing of syndicate items for an emergency.
## Examples Acceptable: - After a war announcement, a Marine Trooper ignores crewmembers carrying contraband so that they can focus on preparing to defend the station. - A Marine Trooper disarms someone attacking them with an energy sword, then uses the sword to kill the attacker.
Prohibited: - A Marine Trooper carries around an energy sword in case of an emergency.
Roles that are included: - A Marine Trooper - The Captain - The Chief Engineer - A assistant promoted to "bounty hunter" - A mime promoted to "Marine Police mime"
Roles that are not included: - A assistant - The clown - An antagonist in any role - A cyborg - A assistant who is helping to fight off nuclear operatives
